premise: On the hottest day Hermit Crab finds the umbrella's cool shade all to himself, then scoots over for Sandpiper, and then for Crab, and the shade is big enough for everyone.
inspiration: The mitten folk tale (Ukrainian: one more animal squeezes in), turned toward the giver: the first one there chooses to make room.
lesson: There's usually room for one more.

en-US.title: Shade for Everyone
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} It was the hottest day of the summer. {hermit-crab:enter} Hermit was so hot {hermit-crab:live hold} he hid right inside his shell. [sighs] Phew. Then he peeked out… {hermit-crab:live resume} and saw {umbrella:enter} the umbrella, red and white, with a cool patch of shade underneath. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Ahh. Lovely. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter} Along ran Sandpiper, {sandpiper:face sad} panting. Hot, hot, hot! Hermit looked at the shade. It was HIS shade. He had found it first. {hermit-crab:face sad} Then he scooted over. [warmly] There's room for two, he said. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Then Crab came scuttling by, red and hot. {hermit-crab:pulse} Room for three! said Hermit. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live} A little breeze came, and the umbrella turned round, fanning them all. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] And the shade, somehow, was big enough for everyone.

es-ES.title: Sombra para todos
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 30s} Era el día más caluroso del verano. {hermit-crab:enter} Cangrejo Ermitaño tenía tanto calor {hermit-crab:live hold} que se metió del todo en su concha. [sighs] Uf. Luego se asomó… {hermit-crab:live resume} y vio {umbrella:enter} la sombrilla, roja y blanca, con una sombra fresquita debajo. {hermit-crab:go under umbrella} {hermit-crab:face happy} Aaah. Qué gusto. [short pause] {sandpiper:enter} Llegó corriendo Correlimos, {sandpiper:face sad} jadeando. ¡Qué calor, qué calor! Ermitaño miró la sombra. Era SU sombra. Él la había encontrado primero. {hermit-crab:face sad} Luego se hizo a un lado. [warmly] Aquí cabemos dos, dijo. {sandpiper:go under umbrella by run} {sandpiper:face happy} {crab:enter} Después pasó Cangrejo correteando, rojo y acalorado. {hermit-crab:pulse} ¡Cabemos tres!, dijo Ermitaño. {crab:go under umbrella} [happily] {umbrella:live} Llegó una brisita, y la sombrilla dio vueltas, abanicándolos a todos. {hermit-crab:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Y la sombra, no se sabe cómo, alcanzó para todos.

breeze.prompt: a soft warm summer breeze and fabric gently flapping, realistic
